[[File:War in Kryta banner.jpg|right|400px]]

[[War in Kryta]] is the first storyline of ''[[Guild Wars Beyond]]''. It includes a series of one-time quests, exclusive items, and repeatable quests. The events begin with the player as an observer to seemingly minor events and end by the player participating in an epic battle to defend Kryta from invaders.

There are two ways to go through the War in Kryta content: following an overarcing quest or without the quest. Regardless of which route you take your character must have access to both ''[[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]]'' and ''[[Guild Wars Eye of the North|Eye of the North]]'', of which one is required to have been completed. If your character has not completed ''Eye of the North'' then either [[The Missing Vanguard]] or the now-removed [[Wintersday Cheer]] and either [[The Knowledgeable Asura]] or [[Zinn's Task]] must be completed. The quest-method is quicker as it allows the player to skip some dialogues and [[War in Kryta encounters|encounters]]; it also directs you through each step. The do-it-yourself method gives the player a richer view of the events leading up to the conclusion. Each method has its own walkthrough:
* The [[The War in Kryta#Walkthrough|quests' walkthrough]];
* Or the [[/Walkthrough|original walkthrough]].

==Lore background==
{{spoiler|''[[Guild Wars Prophecies]]''}}

During the [[Charr invasion]], [[King Jadon]] fled the throne, leaving Kryta leaderless and vulnerable. At that point, [[Saul D'Alessio]] established the White Mantle in the name of his new-found gods, the [[Mursaat|Unseen Ones]], and led them to victory against the [[Charr]], beginning years of Mantle rule in Kryta. In 1072 <small>[[Mouvelian calendar|AE]]</small>, [[Watchman Arad]] [[The Lost Princess|discovered]] that the king sired an illegitimate child who became a priestess at the [[Temple of the Ages]], [[Salma]], and began pushing to get her to the throne. Their efforts gained the support of the Shining Blade, a rebel faction who oppose the White Mantle's rule. The White Mantle lost their [[White Mantle Council|leadership]] and most of their gods, loosening their grip over Kryta.

Since then, Kryta had been plunged into a civil war. Although the conflict is mainly between the Shining Blade and White Mantle, there are various other warlords who have been attempting to seize control themselves. In 1078 <small>AE</small>, the Shining Blade sought the help of the [[Asura]] to find a weapon of power to give them the upper hand in the war, but instead became embroiled in the battle against [[the Great Destroyer]].

===Setting===
;White Mantle
{{quotation|website|Benevolent and Wise Rulers of Kryta.

A militarized religious order that worship cruel “gods” known as the Unseen Ones, the White Mantle once defended Kryta from the charr hordes. But the saviors became tyrants. The Mantle outlawed the worship of the Old Gods and sacrificed innocent Krytans to the bloodthirsty Unseen Ones, who are actually the Mursaat, a race of sinister spellcasters.

Now, the seeds of rebellion have taken root in Kryta. The defiant Shining Blade challenges the supremacy of the White Mantle. But the Mantle will not willingly ease their grip on Kryta, and those who underestimate the Mantle and their Mursaat masters do so at their own peril!}}

;Shining Blade
{{quotation|website|Rebel Defenders of Kryta.

The Shining Blade are freedom fighters who struggle against the oppressive White Mantle for control of Kryta. Lead by the cunning strategist Bartholos, the Shining Blade support the claim of the rightful heir Princess Salma to the Krytan throne.

From their secret jungle base, the Shining Blade wage a guerilla war against the White Mantle, striking without warning and then vanishing into the wilderness. Every day the cruelty of the White Mantle grows, and every day the ranks of the Shining Blade swell with embittered Krytans and freedom-loving adventurers. The final showdown between the royalist rebels and the cruel White Mantle draws near – and Kryta will be changed forevermore!}}

===Timeline===
;Tyrian Events - Thursday, April 8, 2010
''To better serve the [[Kryta]]n people and [https://www.guildwars.com/warinkryta/ maintain order], the [[White Mantle]] has formed the [[Peacekeeper]]s. You'll find these friendly and polite volunteers all through Kryta, offering assistance to common folk and searching for [[Shining Blade|rebel]] sympathizers. Say hello to a Peacekeeper today!''

''Bear witness to the trial of the century! The renowned [[asura]]n artificer [[Zinn]] will stand before the judgment of the [[Arcane Council]] for orchestrating an assassination scheme using [[golem]]s of his design. Speak with [[Chark]] outside of [[Vlox's Falls]] to attend the [[Trial of Zinn|trial]].''

;Tyrian Whispers - Thursday, April 15, 2010
''As hostilities escalate, speculation on coming events can be heard on every corner. Those loyal to [[Princess Salma]] speak of bold measures being conceived in the [[Talmark Wilderness]].''

;Tyrian Events - Thursday, April 29, 2010
''With the recent declaration of war, there's been an upsurge of activity on both sides. Incidents with [[White Mantle]] Inquisitors have been reported from [[Scoundrel's Rise]] to [[Nebo Terrace]]. These interrogations and acts of oppression are likely a response to increased support among the populace for [[Princess Salma]] and the [[Shining Blade]].''

;Tyrian Events - Thursday, May 6, 2010
''The [[Shining Blade]] grows in strength daily, gathering allies and extending aid to travelers troubled by the [[White Mantle]] and their [[Peacekeeper]]s. [[Krytan]]s wait anxiously to hear the outcome of [[Princess Salma]]'s appeals to the [[Ebon Vanguard]]. Meanwhile, the whole of Tyria waits to see when and where [https://www.guildwars.com/warinkryta/ this conflict] will reach its climax.''

;Krytan Happenings - Thursday, May 13, 2010
''[[Lion's Arch]] was the site of excitement this past week as [[Princess Salma]] arrived to claim the throne. With the [[Lionguard]] now committed to the aid of the restored royal line, the people of [[Kryta]] wait to see what forces the [[Ebon Vanguard]] will contribute and whether it will be enough to secure victory in this civil war.''

;Krytan Happenings - Thursday, May 27, 2010
''Emboldened by public response to the royal bounties, [[Princess Salma]] is moving forward with attacks on the [[White Mantle]], stepping up the profile of the targets. Adventurers are urged to do their part in freeing [[Kryta]] from the grip of the [[Mursaat|Unseen Ones']] agents.''

;Krytan Events - Thursday, June 3, 2010
''News has reached [[Lion's Arch]] that the [[Mursaat]] themselves are now exerting some measure of control over [[White Mantle]] operations. Based on this information, [[Princess Salma]] is seeking the assistance of those who've earned the gift of True Sight. The chance to take direct action against the White Mantle's false gods is one the [[Shining Blade]] cannot let pass.''

;Krytan Events - Thursday, June 10, 2010
''The [[Shining Blade]], pleased with adventurers' performance against [[Willem the Demeaning]], are now searching for other [[Mursaat]] in [[Kryta]]. Despite the difficulty in obtaining [[infused]] armor, many [[Henchman|soldiers-for-hire]] are acquiring these pieces to better serve their clientele. Now those who fight for a free Kryta can field a group, in outposts across the land, that will be better protected from the Mursaat's most [[Spectral Agony|vile magic]].''

;Krytan Events - Thursday, June 17, 2010
''[[A Little Help From Above|Success]] against [[Aily the Innocent]] lends much hope to the people of [[Kryta]], but it comes with the realization of how much difficulty remains. With each battle, the [[Shining Blade]] and its allies face tougher foes and see the [[War in Kryta|war]] edge ever closer to the seat of power. [[Princess Salma]] asks that everyone remain vigilant and resolute, as the worst is surely yet to come.''

;Krytan Events - Thursday, July 8, 2010
''Each war has a defining moment. The combined forces of the [[White Mantle]], intent on finally quelling this rebellion and reclaiming the land for their gods, sweep toward [[Lion's Arch]]. The [[Lionguard]], [[Shining Blade]], and [[Ebon Falcons]] stand side by side with common [[Krytan]]s, ready to give their final breath to ensure their way of life outlives subjugation and tyranny. The nation of [[Kryta]] holds its breath, waiting for waves of its oppressors to break upon the last stronghold of hope. The moment is now.''

== Content ==
{{rewrite|section looks very chaotic and has an over-use of sections; it could use some improving}}
''War in Kryta content is available only to characters who have completed the Prophecies or Eye of the North campaigns. If you have completed Prophecies you must also own the Eye of the North expansion.''

=== Enemies ===
Once a character has completed either Prophecies or Eye of the North, different foes will appear in the Kryta regions of Tyria. These foes include:
* Special [[White Mantle]] units and bosses.
* [[Jade construct]]s, including a new [[Jade Cloak]], who work with the mantle.
* [[Peacekeeper]]s, menacing thugs and hooligans who were hired from all the lands of Tyria to support the Mantle and seek out members of the Shining Blade and their supporters.

The War in Kryta enemies can [[drop]] [[List of War in Kryta unique items|unique items]], [[miniature]]s, and [[Confessor's Orders]].

====Encounters with Peacekeepers====
The hired hands of the Mantle are causing troubles to travelers throughout Kryta and there are a number of encounters available in Kryta.

=== Allies ===
Once your character has unlocked the new enemies they will also begin to enjoy the assistance of a variety of familiar allies who will appear as you enter many regions of Kryta.
* Shining Blade allies will begin to spawn from the onset of the new content.
* Ebon Falcons will begin to spawn as allies after viewing the [[War in Kryta dialogues#Dialogue 6 - Captain Langmar Arrives in Lion's Arch|Captain Langmar Arrives in Lion's Arch]] dialogue.

* [[Courier Falken]] will begin spawning after viewing the [[War in Kryta dialogues#Dialogue 4 - Livia Recruits Zinn|Livia Recruits Zinn]] dialogue. He does not count as an escort.

====Courier Falken====
*{{a}} 20 [[Courier Falken]]

[[Courier Falken]] will sometimes appear at the portal as you enter North Kryta Province, Nebo Terrace, and Watchtower Coast areas. He does not count as a Shining Blade or Ebon Falcon escort, so you are able to have both in your party. After he spawns, he will run towards a distant portal, aggroing enemies in range as he goes, and causing groups of White Mantle to appear in his path. He will not resurrect if he dies. If you protect him and help him arrive safely at his destination, he will give you a reward.

=== Explorable area changes ===
Many of the regions of Kryta change as the character unlocks key portions of the evolving story.

;The Shining Blade Camp
The southern area of [[Talmark Wilderness]] features encounters with Shining Blade scouts, while [[Dakutu Village]] has been settled as the [[Shining Blade Camp]].
* The camp is permanent, but the NPCs appearing here change as the story progresses.
* This location is where you will encounter the majority of the [[War in Kryta dialogues|main dialogues]] which progress the story of the War in Kryta and unlock new content.

;Other appearances
* [[Chark]] will appear in [[Arbor Bay]] once you have completed either EotN or the quest [[Zinn's Task]]. He will lead you to the [[Trial of Zinn]].
* [[Lieutenant Thackeray]] will appear in the [[Hall of Monuments]] upon completion of EotN or [[Wintersday Cheer]] or [[A Good Deed]], and begin [[Hearts of the North dialogues|dialogues with Gwen]]. These dialogues are part of [[Hearts of the North]], but are required for the War in Kryta content.
* Following the dialogues with Gwen, Thackeray will appear in [[Ice Cliff Chasms]], asking for [[Thackeray's scavenger hunt|help with a picnic]]. Completing his task will return him to the Hall of Monuments again, where you witness one more dialogue. After this, and once your character has seen the [[War in Kryta dialogues#Dialogue 2 - Search for Allies|second dialogue at the Shining Blade Camp]], Evennia will appear in the Ice Cliff Chasms with [[War in Kryta dialogues#Dialogue 5 - Evennia Recruits the Ebon Vanguard|more dialogue]].
* Captain Langmar will appear in Lion's Arch Keep after the dialogue with Evennia in Ice Cliff Chasms.

==== New explorable areas ====
Several areas are available only to supporters of the revolution. They can be unlocked by watching the appropriate [[War in Kryta dialogues]]. (See the [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] and the [[/Walkthrough|walkthrough]] section of this article for more detail on unlocking content.)

; After watching Livia recruit Zinn
* [[Lion's Arch Keep]] — from [[Lion's Arch]]; speak to the [[Lion's Arch Keep Gate Guard]].
* [[Divinity Coast (explorable area)|Divinity Coast]] (and [[Zinn's laboratory]]) — through the [[Secret River Passage]], near the North East portal in [[Talmark Wilderness (War in Kryta)]].

; After Salma takes up residence in Lion's Arch Keep
* [[Riverside Province (explorable area)|Riverside Province]] — from [[Sanctum Cay (outpost)]]; speak to [[Blade Operative Paulina]].
* [[D'Alessio Seaboard (explorable area)|D'Alessio Seaboard]] — from [[Lion's Arch]]; speak to [[Jiaju Tai]] (at the docks).

=== Quests ===
Once you have unlocked Lion's Arch Keep, you can access new quest content.

==== Wanted / Shining Blade bounty ====
[[Wanted by the Shining Blade]] is a quest series available in Lion's Arch Keep similar to [[Zaishen Bounty|Zaishen Bounties]] that targets White Mantle and Peacekeeper Bosses. Various gold and collector rewards are available. Speak to Salma to receive the rewards.

==== Covert Operations ====
Princess Salma offers the following quests once certain Shining Blade bounties are completed (see the quest page for details).
* [[Riverside Assassination]]
* [[A Little Help From Above]]
* [[Temple of the Intolerable]]
* [[Mustering a Response]]
* [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]]

=== Collectors and items ===
The War in Kryta also includes items and collectors otherwise unavailable in Guild Wars.

==== Items ====
There are several items exclusive to the War in Kryta:
* Confessor's Orders drop from the White Mantle and Peacekeepers; they can be traded for War Supplies.
* [[War Supplies]], obtained by completing Shining Blade Bounties, by assisting Courier Falken, or from collectors in exchange for Confessor's Orders.
* [[Medal of Honor|Medals of Honor]] are available by completing certain quests or by exchanging War Supplies. They can be exchanged with collectors for [[Oppressor's Weapon]]s or commemorative War in Kryta Weapons.
* [[Royal Gift]]s are similarly available through quests or exchange. When opened, they drop items including some available elsewhere in Guild Wars and also several items exclusive to the War in Kryta:
** 3 miniatures: [[Miniature Evennia|Evennia]], [[Miniature Livia|Livia]], [[Miniature Salma|Salma]]
** 3 consumables: [[Krytan Brandy]], [[Krytan Lokum]], and [[Shining Blade Rations]]
** 1 summoning stone: [[Shining Blade War Horn]]
* 2 miniatures are available as random drops from the White Mantle: [[Miniature Confessor Dorian|Confessor Dorian]] and [[Miniature Confessor Isaiah|Confessor Isaiah]]
* 1 miniature is available as a random drop from the Peacekeepers: [[Miniature Peacekeeper Enforcer|Peacekeeper Enforcer]]
* 16 unique items are available as random drops from War in Kryta mobs: [[List of War in Kryta unique items]] (those not followed by "Commemorative Weapons")

==Notes==
* The only purchasable content for War in Kryta are the [[costume]]s.
* After The Battle for Lion's Arch:
** You can visit Lion's Arch Keep at any time and meet with the collectors there to exchange Confessor's Orders, War Supplies, and Medals of Honor.
** Shining Blade bounties will remain available.
** Kryta returns to its normal spawns, unless you take a bounty — having any ''Wanted!'' quest active means that ''all'' of Kryta will be as it was during the War, regardless of the target's location.
** Your character will be able to begin the next installment of Guild Wars Beyond, [[Hearts of the North]].
* After completing WiK's required quests, each character will earn 90,000 [[experience]], 17 {{plat}}, 60 War Supplies, 23 Royal Gifts, and 7 Medals of Honor. (One can earn an additional 30 War Supplies by completing the required bounties in [[hard mode]].)
